name: Tempester 1.6.4.0-c — exact version and Pad Function mode announced (test)
description: 1.6.3.0 plus n°39 and n°40, a test image for the coordinator (no version digit of its own: the screens still show 1.6.3.0, so n°39 announces 1.6.3.0). n°39: the request F0 01 28 43 F7 answers F0 01 28 43 a1 a0 b1 b0 c1 c0 d1 d0 F7 on the cable set in System: the exact version a.b.c.d, each digit as two 7-bit bytes, read at run time from the version digits of the System screen that tools/patch_version.py writes; the identity reply is unchanged. n°40: the Pad Function mode (0 16 Beats, 1 16 Time Steps, 2 16 Sounds, 3 16 Tunings, 4 16 Mutes, 5 16 Levels) goes out as CC 106 = mode on Remote Pad OUT whenever it changes and after a full-state request CC 107, with the rules of the other reports (nothing while Remote Pad OUT is Off, at most 16 bytes waiting in the DIN send ring). Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
